featured.headline: Kyiv rushes backup bridges after Russian strikes
featured.summary: Kyiv allocates UAH 2.2bn for two backup crossings by February after Russia hit the Northern and Southern bridges; traffic partly restored for vehicles under 10 tonnes.

featured.headline: Iran says drones hit US base in Kuwait
featured.summary: Iran's army says its drones struck Patriot defences and US platforms at Ali Al Salem Air Base early Wednesday; Bahrain and Kuwait say they countered hostile drones.

featured.headline: Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen on eve of Trump talks
featured.summary: Xi and Putin hold their fifth meeting this year, on Ukraine, Iran and nuclear arms, a day before the first trilateral summit with Trump.

featured.headline: Trump lands in Shenzhen; Xi greets him on the tarmac
featured.summary: Trump arrives for APEC to a rare airport welcome from Xi; the two shake hands with Putin at the evening banquet.

featured.headline: Israel opens concentrated operation in central Gaza
featured.summary: The IDF begins an operation in three areas of central Gaza as Trump's Board of Peace warns the ceasefire 'cannot be sustained indefinitely'.

featured.headline: Peltola flips Alaska; Democrats take Senate 56–44
featured.summary: AP calls Alaska for Democrat Mary Peltola, 50.1% to 45.8%, the ninth Democratic flip and the last Senate race called.

featured.headline: Dow slides 1.1% as Fed minutes point to more hikes
featured.summary: The Dow falls 561 points to 50,198, a third straight loss; the S&P 500 drops a fifth day while the Nasdaq gains 0.42%.

featured.headline: Cyclone Akvan bears down on Odisha
featured.summary: Severe cyclonic storm Akvan strengthens off India's east coast; Odisha moves people from unsafe houses to shelters ahead of a 20 November landfall.

featured.headline: Alcaraz sweeps Medvedev into ATP Finals semis
featured.summary: World No. 3 beats Medvedev 6-2, 6-4 in 72 minutes in Turin; Tiafoe's win over Cobolli seals his group top spot.

featured.headline: Morocco, Senegal book AFCON 2027 places
featured.summary: Six nations — Morocco, Senegal, Cameroon, Benin, Burkina Faso and Mali — seal spots at the 2027 finals in East Africa with two rounds to spare.

featured.headline: Hegseth signs US–Venezuela military pact in Caracas
featured.summary: Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth signs a cooperation deal with interim President Delcy Rodríguez on a surprise visit, then flies to Colombia with a C-130.

featured.headline: India–US trade deal nearly done; signing waits on tariffs
featured.summary: India's commerce secretary says talks are nearly complete, but signing awaits a new US tariff framework.

featured.headline: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Arabia; coalition hits back
featured.summary: Houthi forces claim aerial attacks on Saudi Arabia; the Saudi-led coalition says it struck 60 Houthi targets and downed a cruise missile aimed at Riyadh.

featured.headline: Anthropic prices record $81.3bn IPO at $83
featured.summary: Anthropic prices 980 million shares at $83, above its $70–78 range, in the largest IPO on record; ANT starts trading on Nasdaq on Thursday.

featured.headline: 16 killed as drone hits school sheltering displaced in Sudan
featured.summary: Monitors report a Sudanese army drone struck a school sheltering displaced people in Ghabish, West Kordofan, killing 16 and wounding 10; the report first emerged on Wednesday.

featured.headline: Ethiopia, Eritrea mass troops at border
featured.summary: Conflict monitors say Ethiopia and Eritrea have amassed forces along their shared border, fuelling fears of outright war.
